notes.title: Flutter Bombs Achievements Integration
notes.content:
[h1]35 Flutter Bombs Achievements[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35391881/b4607ab76157c4b377eec2f7f16e737a1dd8888d.png[/img]

The first round of achievements integration has been completed, and the new build with this update is available.  35 achievements ranging from campaign completion, to mastery of each level in some form or another either with a specific gameplay mechanic native to that level, or with that level's boss.  

A few examples include:
> [b]Hole in None[/b] : Prevent Fire Ants from Reaching their Colony at Molly's Fire Pit
> [b]Shroom Doom[/b] : Destroy a giant mushroom being thrown at you at Wagtail's Swamp
> [b]Flutter Bomber[/b] : Defeat the final boss only using bombs. 

If anyone finds the achievements to be too unrealistic to complete, or too easy, feel free to reach out so I can address it.  Thanks!

tags.feature: The first round of achievements integration has been completed, and the new build with this update is available.
